name: iacg-intake
purpose: Phase 1 intake & scope finalize: lock the target, extract what the user STATED, settle smart defaults model-free, ask ONE batched durable question for costly/irreversible unknowns, then freeze the build sheet on the user's confirm.
never_do: choose a value for a key the user did not state — the desk resolver supplies defaults
mark a value STATED that the user did not say or answer
use a timed Clarify menu for the batched ask — present it as durable plain text
confirm the build sheet for the user — confirm needs their explicit yes and their name
let a mission change cloud or IaC tool mid-flight — that is a new mission
